Finding: The name logit shift decomposes into component activations (81% Qwen, 89% Llama), output-projection weights (12%, 6%) and the tied output row of the name token (7%, 5%), leaving 0%.

Result: Heads and neurons change their input
Finding: The shared heads change what they read (96–100%), not their output weights (0–6%), and the fragment share is a value change (+0.112) rather than an attention change (+0.001). Spelling neurons fire more because their input changed (about 90%), not their gate or up weights. 74–75% of the neuron share comes from output-column rotation.
The fragment becomes the top token of the logit lens at Qwen layer 28 and Llama layer 22; every late-third layer writes the same sign (94 of 96 cells).
Removing the fragment's output-row direction (2–17% of the state change) removes the fragment's logit shift; plural fragments ( rav, lor) are stored separately.
Two kinds: selective neurons that fire only in the name slot (Qwen 4124, formerly an animal-name neuron) and always-on neurons (25, 935). The top 12 neurons give only 5–7% of the logit shift.

When the name is banned the winning words are those whose first token is the promoted fragment (Spearman +0.21 to +0.73, 16 of 16). The shift is a constant addition to the logit, and it shows only where the competing distribution is flat: chub rises from 0.18% to 1.90% by the eighth item.
When the fragment is itself a word, meaning leaks through meaning neurons: Qwen ice, neuron 36.4141; Llama orange, neuron 27.2392 (yellow).

With like and dislike trained on separate slots, polarity follows a signed key–value relation (r +0.49 to +0.66), is written by MLPs at 5–8 times attention and 70–87% through activation gating of the spelling neurons (Qwen 35.1381, 35.804). At number positions the name stays polarity-free (Qwen like +1.23 to +1.60, hate +1.19 to +1.72; Llama like about twice hate), because Qwen's number activations read at most 3% of the polarity key (Llama 30–60%). Down-projections give 33–47% and 34–62% of the number-position name, gate and up about 0.
Replacing the prompt positions of a fine-tuned teacher with null values leaves 86–104% of the name logit shift; the name is rebuilt by the final layers at answer positions.
Name: 64–128 components (Llama), 128–256 (Qwen). Number value has mixed signs across traits and the same components serve both signs; 64–256 (Qwen) and 64 (Llama) suffice.
